name: Affordly
tagline: Housing affordability by city with interactive charts and machine-learning price forecasts.

awards: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: Housing affordability data is hard for ordinary people to read.
solution: Combines income requirements, comparisons across metros and ML price forecasts in an interactive web app.
demo_moment: Team-described: compare cities and see the forecast.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 112 submissions.
Inspired by consumer finance apps that make data approachable.

lessons: Borrow the clarity of consumer finance apps for another dataset.
